re_evaluation_2026-08-18.reason: src/cop/memory/scent.py::ScentField.advance() was missing Appendix E's upper clamp (min(source_strength, ...)) -- a cell an agent revisited repeatedly had no ceiling. training/belief_tracker.py uses this exact ScentField class during self-play, so the evaluate_metrics this checkpoint was originally promoted against (recorded below) were measured under the uncapped formula.
re_evaluation_2026-08-18.verdict: no retrain needed -- re-ran only the evaluate stage (orchestrate_pipeline.py --stage evaluate --run-id belief_ensemble_final_ensemble) against the same, unretrained checkpoint under the fixed formula. Both win rates held or improved; win_rate_vs_baseline_belief_aware moved from below the 0.6 target (0.57) to above it (0.625), so the human_sign_off exception below no longer describes the checkpoint's current, real performance -- left unedited as an accurate record of the decision actually made on 2026-08-13, not because it's still the live number.

warm_up_match_history.first_pass: FAILED — 0/20 captures vs greedy_thief_move, a real infinite two-state movement oscillation caught by an uncounted local warm-up match, invisible to the official win_rate_vs_baseline metric (which only ever evaluates against make_random_walk_thief)
warm_up_match_history.root_cause: a sparsely-explored Q-table state's only recorded row entry was the exact reverse of a well-learned neighbouring state's own best move; greedy inference cycled between the two forever
warm_up_match_history.fix_description: RLCopBrain now tracks the direction it just moved and skips the exact reverse when ranking legal actions, falling back to it only when genuinely the only legal option
warm_up_match_history.revalidation: 148/150 captures across 3 opponent types (greedy_thief_move, lookahead_evader_thief, make_random_walk_thief; 50 trials each), zero oscillation/entrapment failures
warm_up_match_history.known_residual_finding: a self-entrapment pathology (a seed walling itself into a 2-cell dead end via its own barrier placements) is confirmed present in one individual seed (belief_ensemble_final_seed7) but not observed in the merged ensemble across the broadened validation above — documented as a legitimate follow-up in rule_audit_report.md, not treated as a blocker for this promotion

human_sign_off.belief_aware_win_rate_below_0_6_target: acknowledged, promote anyway — ensemble beats every one of its 20 seeds and the pre-layer baseline (0.38) by a wide margin; improved further to 0.57 after the backtrack-guard fix
human_sign_off.quantized_checkpoint_chosen: yes — 99.94% argmax-agreement, matches this project's established per-row quantization pipeline; the unusually small 1.58% size reduction was noted but not treated as a blocker
